learning_outcomes.text: Makes basic geometric drawings. Draws the principal views from pictorial drawings. Understands objects from existing principal views and draws missing views.
Makes dimensioning of the views of the objects.
Knows the sectioning methods and applies them.
Performs three-dimensional solid modelling using CAD software.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to technical drawing: Basic concepts.
Two-dimensional sketching techniques in CAD environment (sketch relations, sketch tools)
Geometric construction applications in CAD environment.
Principles of orthographic projection: Principal views of parts. Freehand drawing practices for drawing of the views.
Drawing the six principal views of objects based on their pictorial drawings and CAD applications.
Drawing the six principal views of objects based on their pictorial drawings and CAD applications.
Drawing the other (missing) views of parts using the given principal views. CAD applications.
Principles of sectioning: Full, half, offset and aligned sections, revolved/ removed sections, broken-out sections and relevant conventions. CAD applications.
Three-dimensional solid modelling: Commands for solid creation, editing, and creating reference geometry. Applications of creating solid models from pictorial drawings.
Three-dimensional solid modelling: Commands for solid creation, editing, and creating reference geometry. Applications of creating solid models from pictorial drawings.
Three-dimensional solid modelling. Commands for solid creation, editing, and creating reference geometry. Applications of creating solid models using provided principal views.
Technical drawing applications in CAD environment: Sheet properties, obtaining principal and auxiliary views and perspectives, dimensioning.
bibliography: İ. Zeki Şen, Nail Özçilingir, Teknik Resim-Temel Bilgiler, Deha Yayıncılık.
Giesecke, E. Frederick, et. al., Technical Drawing with Engineering Graphics (16th Edition), Pearson Education Inc., 2023.
